purpose: 为所有中英证据图提供图名、核心判断、京张场地依据、状态限制和证据入口，避免图像文字缺失或视觉精度替代事实精度。

figures.title: 三层范围与一带三区两翼
figures.core_judgement: 三个尺度不是三张互不关联的地图，而是从统筹研究到总体设计再到重点区试验的证据递进。
figures.jingzhang_grounding: 使用任务文字中的43.6平方公里、约11.4平方公里和三个重点区域角色；不把暂定几何升级为官方边界。
figures.status_and_limit: NTS; provisional; relationship diagram; not a statutory map; not deployed.
figures.title_en: Three scales and One Belt–Three Areas–Two Wings
figures.core_judgement_en: The three scales form an evidence progression, not three unrelated maps.
figures.jingzhang_grounding_en: Uses the brief's 43.6 km², about 11.4 km² and three focus-area roles without upgrading provisional geometry.

figures.title: 稳定公共底盘、可逆场景层与治理版本层
figures.core_judgement: AI快变量不能反向锁定遗产、通行、蓝绿和基本公共服务等慢变量。
figures.jingzhang_grounding: 回应京张遗址公园、既有街区与创新活动在同一走廊叠合的冲突。
figures.status_and_limit: Conceptual layer model; no parcel allocation, FAR, ownership or construction inference.
evidence_entry: proposal.md#总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
figures.title_en: Stable public base, reversible scenario layer and version layer
figures.core_judgement_en: Fast-changing AI must not lock in heritage, access, blue-green space or basic public services.
figures.jingzhang_grounding_en: Responds to the overlap of the railway park, existing neighbourhoods and innovation activities.

figures.title: 三处重点区与六个首期具象点
figures.core_judgement: 每个重点区只选择两个可讨论、可停用的首期服务原型，不以平均铺开代替实施选择。
figures.jingzhang_grounding: 众智园侧重可信测试，AI原点侧重开源共创，大钟寺侧重需求和公共权益核查。
figures.status_and_limit: Text-only or provisional area anchors; no coordinates, buildings, station exits or road alignments.
figures.title_en: Three focus areas and six first moves
figures.core_judgement_en: Each area starts with two reversible service prototypes rather than uniform build-out.
figures.jingzhang_grounding_en: Zhongzhiyuan tests, AI Origin co-creates, and Dazhongsi validates demand and public rights.

figures.title: 交通、蓝绿与公共服务连续性
figures.core_judgement: 物理连续、服务连续和治理连续必须同时成立；数字服务不能替代通行、休憩与人工入口。
figures.jingzhang_grounding: 对应铁路公园、小月河、站城转换和三处重点区之间的公共旅程。
figures.status_and_limit: Service blueprint; no transport engineering, river-control or accessibility compliance claim.
evidence_entry: proposal.md#交通轨道市政与公共服务设施
figures.core_judgement_en: Physical, service and governance continuity must work together.
figures.jingzhang_grounding_en: Connects railway-park, Xiaoyue River, station-city and focus-area user journeys.

figures.title: 指标—证据—反馈闭环
figures.core_judgement: 指标不是装饰性KPI，而是触发保留、修正、暂停、退出和版本复算的规划反馈。
figures.jingzhang_grounding: 将三区六点和日周季年运营接入同一状态、责任和事件记录。
figures.status_and_limit: Unknown baselines remain unknown; no fabricated performance values.
evidence_entry: proposal.md#指标体系面积复算与合规矩阵
figures.core_judgement_en: Metrics trigger retain, revise, pause, exit and recalculation decisions.
figures.jingzhang_grounding_en: Places the six first moves and operating calendar in one state and event ledger.

figures.title: 七个规划生产角色与证据闸门
figures.core_judgement: Agent通过有边界的任务、交接和反证改变规划判断，而不是自动替代规划师。
figures.jingzhang_grounding: 六类官方任务由统筹角色整合，并在京张公园和大钟寺两次桌面实验中接受人类门否决。
figures.status_and_limit: Planning-production workflow; not an organisational commitment or deployed city Agent system.
figures.title_en: Seven planning-production roles and evidence gates
figures.core_judgement_en: Agents change planning through bounded tasks, handoffs and counter-evidence—not automation.
figures.jingzhang_grounding_en: Two tabletop tests at the railway park and Dazhongsi record human rejection and plan revision.

figures.title: 全球案例机制与海淀创新接力
figures.core_judgement: 案例只迁移机制和成立条件，不复制园区造型、规模或绩效。
figures.jingzhang_grounding: 将研究、开源、测试、孵化、资本、市场和治理分配到三区两翼的接力关系。
figures.status_and_limit: Comparative mechanism research; no claim that named local organisations have committed resources.
evidence_entry: proposal.md#创新生态七个全球案例转译为八段接力
figures.title_en: Global mechanisms and the Haidian innovation relay
figures.core_judgement_en: Cases transfer mechanisms and conditions, not forms, scale or performance.
figures.jingzhang_grounding_en: Links research, open source, testing, incubation, capital, market and governance across the belt.

figures.title: 十三张AI原生场景卡总览
figures.core_judgement: 场景必须同时写清用户任务、空间载体、AI边界、人工接管、非数字替代和退出。
figures.jingzhang_grounding: 覆盖众智园受控测试、AI原点共创、大钟寺试用以及铁路公园公共文化界面。
figures.status_and_limit: Scenario hypotheses; not deployed services and not evidence of local demand.
figures.core_judgement_en: Every scenario specifies user task, spatial carrier, AI limits, human fallback and exit.
figures.jingzhang_grounding_en: Covers controlled testing, co-creation, public culture and demand validation across Jingzhang.

figures.title: 日—周—季—年运营与六段转化
figures.core_judgement: 活动只有形成问题、项目、测试、应用和公开复盘的转化链，才构成长效运营。
figures.jingzhang_grounding: 北段可信测试、中段开源协作和南段公众体验共同构成年度旗舰旅程。
figures.status_and_limit: Operating proposal; real organisers, budget, venues and baselines remain unknown.
evidence_entry: proposal.md#更新项目清单实施政策与分期计划
figures.core_judgement_en: Events matter only when they close the issue-to-project-to-test-to-learning loop.
figures.jingzhang_grounding_en: Forms an annual relay from northern testing through central co-creation to southern public review.

figures.title: 八类用户旅程与人工退级
figures.core_judgement: 每类用户都应能到达、理解、选择、获得人工帮助并退出或申诉。
figures.jingzhang_grounding: 覆盖居民、老年与非数字用户、青年开发者、研究创业团队、运营者和国内外访客。
figures.status_and_limit: Method personas only; not demographic statistics, interview results or satisfaction evidence.
evidence_entry: proposal.md#ai医疗教育商业进入街区的边界
figures.title_en: Eight user journeys and human fallback
figures.core_judgement_en: Every user can arrive, understand, choose, obtain human help, exit and appeal.
figures.jingzhang_grounding_en: Covers residents, non-digital users, developers, research teams, operators and visitors.

figures.title: 三个AI地标与十二类可逆组件
figures.core_judgement: AI地标首先是可理解、可纠错的公共服务系统，而非固定科技奇观。
figures.jingzhang_grounding: 开发者散步道·开源成果里程廊、智能体贡献荣誉墙和京张AI时光站叠加既有铁路公园公共底盘。
figures.status_and_limit: Reversible prototype family; no fixed location, heritage approval or construction promise.
evidence_entry: proposal.md#蓝绿空间公共空间与城市风貌
figures.title_en: Three AI landmarks and twelve reversible components
figures.core_judgement_en: AI landmarks are correctable public-service systems, not fixed technology spectacles.
figures.jingzhang_grounding_en: Adds three low-impact prototypes to the existing railway-park public base.

figures.title: 命名树、Logo构图语法与视觉候选
figures.core_judgement: 项目总标题、概念名、片区名、场景名和活动名按层级管理，视觉以证据之线而非科技炫技组织。
figures.jingzhang_grounding: 铁路连接、中关村开放创新与AI可追溯性共同形成识别语法。
figures.status_and_limit: Candidate identity directions; not a released logo or third-party brand licence.
figures.title_en: Naming tree, logo grammar and identity candidates
figures.core_judgement_en: One naming hierarchy connects the project title to reversible points and components.
figures.jingzhang_grounding_en: Combines railway connection, Zhongguancun openness and AI traceability.

figures.title: 四张完整场景卡与0—4证据成熟度
figures.core_judgement: 场景从文字核验到受控开放逐级推进，任何一级失败都可退回而不破坏公共底盘。
figures.jingzhang_grounding: 选取医疗、教育、商业和公共空间代表场景，分别对应京张沿线的日常服务和创新任务。
figures.status_and_limit: Maturity ladder is a governance proposal, not deployment status.
figures.title_en: Four complete scenarios and the 0–4 evidence ladder
figures.core_judgement_en: Scenarios advance by evidence and can fall back without damaging the public base.
figures.jingzhang_grounding_en: Tests representative health, education, commerce and public-space situations.

figures.title: 三文化、五类导览与纠错回路
figures.core_judgement: 百年铁路、中关村与AI新文化可以并置解释，但不能补写未经证实的历史因果。
figures.jingzhang_grounding: 以铁路遗产、创新史和当代开源贡献组织可纸本验证、可更正、可撤回的导览。
figures.status_and_limit: Narrative framework; route geometry and third-party rights require verification.
evidence_entry: proposal.md#三种文化的非因果叙事
figures.title_en: Three cultures, five route types and correction loop
figures.core_judgement_en: Railway, Zhongguancun and AI cultures can be interpreted together without inventing causality.
figures.jingzhang_grounding_en: Organises sourced heritage, innovation history and open-source contribution into correctable routes.

figures.title: 十五项专业深度合同证据界面
figures.core_judgement: 每项专业判断都必须显式说明输入、指标、缺口、复算触发和签署责任。
figures.jingzhang_grounding: 覆盖范围、用地、交通、蓝绿、建筑、更新、公共空间、产业、韧性与治理等京张必要专业接口。
figures.status_and_limit: Complete with limitations; no substitute for official data or professional sign-off.
evidence_entry: proposal.md#用地建筑规模与拆改留方案
figures.core_judgement_en: Every professional judgement states inputs, metrics, gaps, recalculation and sign-off responsibility.
figures.jingzhang_grounding_en: Covers the spatial, mobility, blue-green, building, renewal, industry and governance interfaces Jingzhang needs.

figures.title: 现状遥感底图图册
figures.core_judgement: 遥感只用于观察粗粒度肌理、范围关系和提出待核问题，不用于反推控制线和工程结论。
figures.jingzhang_grounding: 同一景Sentinel-2背景覆盖统筹范围、总体走廊和众智园、AI原点、大钟寺三个研究视窗。
figures.status_and_limit: 10 m-class background raster; not cadastral, statutory, engineering or ownership evidence.
figures.core_judgement_en: Remote sensing supports coarse context and questions, not statutory or engineering inference.
figures.jingzhang_grounding_en: One Sentinel-2 scene covers the coordination area, corridor and three study windows.

figures.title: AI时代城市规划的五组范式转变
figures.core_judgement: AI只有把证据、判断、情景、实施和反馈组织成可追溯、可纠错的系统，才真正改变规划。
figures.jingzhang_grounding: 京张将遗产慢变量、AI快变量、街区公共性与证据缺口置于同一压力测试。
figures.status_and_limit: Planning method diagram; not statutory approval, automated decision or implementation evidence.
evidence_entry: proposal.md#面向ai时代的城市规划专业总判断
figures.title_en: Five planning-paradigm shifts for the AI era
figures.core_judgement_en: AI changes planning only when evidence, judgement, scenarios, implementation and feedback form a traceable and correctable system.
figures.jingzhang_grounding_en: Jingzhang stress-tests slow heritage variables, fast AI change, neighbourhood public value and evidence gaps together.

figures.title: AI时代的五维规划对象
figures.core_judgement: AI场景必须同时具备空间、任务、接口、时间和治理合同；可变层退出后公共底盘仍完整。
figures.jingzhang_grounding: 对应京张公园、街区首层、受控测试和公共服务等不同载体的准入、运行与退出要求。
figures.status_and_limit: Planning-object framework; not a substitute for statutory plans, permits or professional sign-off.
evidence_entry: proposal.md#面向ai时代的城市规划专业总判断
figures.title_en: Five-dimensional planning object for the AI era
figures.core_judgement_en: Every AI scenario needs space, task, interface, time and governance contracts; the public base remains intact when variable layers exit.
figures.jingzhang_grounding_en: Applies admission, operation and exit rules across Jingzhang park, street-level services, controlled testing and public-service settings.

figures.title: 当城市开始思考：京张AI原生城市文明试验场全景愿景
figures.core_judgement: 京张的未来性不来自孤立技术奇观，而来自铁路公共脊梁承载遗产、日常生活、创新协作与可逆AI服务的长期共生。
figures.jingzhang_grounding: 以铁路遗产、公园连续性、三类重点区任务和普通公众使用为叙事依据，不复原或虚构具体建筑落位。
figures.status_and_limit: AI-generated communication concept; not a site photograph, reconstruction, statutory plan, approved location, construction rendering or commitment.
evidence_entry: proposal.md#传播母题当城市开始思考百年京张的ai原生城市文明试验场
figures.title_en: When the City Begins to Think: panoramic vision of an AI-native Jingzhang
figures.core_judgement_en: Jingzhang's future value comes from a public railway spine supporting heritage, everyday life, innovation and reversible AI services—not an isolated technology spectacle.
figures.jingzhang_grounding_en: Uses the heritage railway, park continuity, three study-area tasks and ordinary public use as narrative cues without reconstructing or locating specific buildings.
